tools.name: search_packages
tools.description: Searches holiday packages (flight + hotel) to one destination country. Returns packages with hotel name, stars, guest rating, board, departure date and airports, total and per-person price, and a link to book on the brand's website. Filters: dates, nights, travellers, departure airport, price, stars

tools.name: search_inspirations
tools.description: Suggests holiday destinations for a natural-language request (e.g. 'warm beach in November with small children'). Returns destination ideas with an indicative package price per person, the reason each one matches, and the countryCode that search_packages accepts. Suited to requests without a chosen

tools.name: get_regions
tools.description: Lists the regions and cities of one destination country, with names and codes; a code narrows search_packages through its regionCode parameter. Read-only.

tools.name: get_countries
tools.description: Lists the destination countries available for holiday package search, with names and the two-letter country codes used by search_packages. Read-only.
